newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israel's Elron Electronic Q3 EPS $0.12.
newsitem.headline: Israel's Elron Electronic Q3 EPS $0.12.

text.p: Elron, an electronics holding company, said its share in the net income of affiliated companies fell to $0.4 million in the third quarter from $1.3 million a year earlier. It did not explain the reason for the decline. Elron's biggest affiliate, Elbit Ltd, contributed $1.4 million to consolidated net income, versus $1.1 million a year earlier.

Other income amounted to $2.7 million for the quarter, up from $1.7 million a year ago. The increase was attributable to $3 million realised from the increased value of the company's shares in Orbotech Ltd and NetManage.
The shares were transferred to Elron's securities account in the quarter in order to sell them.
Elron declared a third-quarter dividend of $0.06 a share payable December 23.
